scope: CPU diagnostic of 64-to-32 capture reduction only, no parallax, specular, shadows, rasterization or browser PBR. Baseline is lighting of stored 64px normals, not original geometry. Quadratic transfer is the order-two clamped-cosine expansion, not a shipping shader. Summaries sum texel areas across the 81 sampled views, without spherical solid-angle weighting or deduplication; they are not whole-canopy lighting integrals. Per-view relative error is null when baseline energy is negligible.
